R4D-deer-atv-0003.name: 870 m E of Lower Arrow Lake
R4D-deer-atv-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R4D-deer-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Applegrove Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-4-001 unit 176 (official), right here. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2017 (9 years old), right here.
Burn from 2021 (fire N51800, 22,042 ha), right here.
NW facing slope, 15 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: 4 point bucks: antlers must accompany the species licence
bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 79 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 6, Starlite Rd, Applegrove Rd.
Park: 49.74303, -118.10916, where the truck road ends (Applegrove Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.3 km on Octopus Road by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 60 m S, climb about 15 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2017 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-15, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4D-deer-atv-0003.recDirections: Due to private land issues this site has been changed to BOAT ACCESS ONLY
R4D-deer-atv-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-15: about 2,707 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.51 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 15 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
